scenario.label: Jezero / Marte — supuestos EVA basados en analogía lunar
scenario.note: Mobility, time and reserve assumptions use lunar analogues for lack of a public Mars standard. Suit budget is a project scenario, not a Mars suit capacity; not NASA GO/NO-GO.
scenario.provenance: Defaults only: 2 km/h flat is an Artemis ConOps planning assumption/TBR, not a universal average; return speed is a project assumption. 20 min/stop is informed by Apollo station times, not universal. 15+15 min overhead is an optimistic project assumption. Fixed 30 min is an Apollo analog; 60 min / 2 km are lunar-analog constraints. Overrides are user-supplied, not sourced by these analogues.

return_contingency.note: Straight-line distance is a geometric lower bound, not a traversable route. Flat-speed radial time is a proxy, not a lower bound on terrain-aware return time; exceeding it does not prove a real time violation. Neither check validates return. Independent check, not added to operational time.
return_contingency.path_note: Fastest modeled return from each science waypoint, or the farthest radial route point if there are no science waypoints. Limits apply to this path only; exceeding one does not prove no alternative path can satisfy both. Not added to planned return or fixed reserve; terrain model is not field validation.
